about: The central point of each piece in WIA's published log (E.B25 (f)), derived once from the committed published-content log (research/chatgpt-export-2026-10-18/kb-candidates/published-content-log.md), never from the export itself (R52). Each entry names the log row the context seed records (source_kind export_seed, source_ref), its first publish date (date_precision says how exact the log is) and its central point as the engineer read it under D21. `storage_cli context-published-points` confirms the rows with these dates and points; the card verifier flags a card that repeats a point published in the last twelve months.
